## Findings

This is the **memos** Go project (module `github.com/usememos/memos`). SSO / federated identity lives under `internal/idp`.

### (a) Provider abstraction package

**`internal/idp`** — path `/bench/repo/internal/idp/idp.go`

Package `idp` defines the shared identity-provider abstraction. It declares the protocol-agnostic `IdentityProviderUserInfo` struct (fields: `Identifier`, `DisplayName`, `Email`, `AvatarURL`) that every concrete provider must produce from a federated login. Its import path is `github.com/usememos/memos/internal/idp`, and concrete implementations depend on it (see the import at line 15 of oauth2.go and the return type `*idp.IdentityProviderUserInfo` at line 83).

Note: the abstraction here is a thin, data-oriented contract (a shared user-info type + the package acting as the parent namespace) rather than a Go `interface`. Concrete providers conform by exposing `NewIdentityProvider`, `ExchangeToken`, and `UserInfo` methods that return `*idp.IdentityProviderUserInfo`.

### (b) Concrete protocol implementation package

**`internal/idp/oauth2`** — path `/bench/repo/internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go`

Package `oauth2` "implements the OAuth2 identity provider integration" (file doc comment, line 1). It defines a concrete `IdentityProvider` struct backed by `storepb.OAuth2Config`, with:
- `NewIdentityProvider(config *storepb.OAuth2Config)` (line 27)
- `ExchangeToken(...)` — OAuth2 authorization-code exchange with PKCE support (line 47)
- `UserInfo(...)` — calls the userinfo endpoint and maps claims into `idp.IdentityProviderUserInfo` (line 83)

It uses `golang.org/x/oauth2` for the actual protocol handling. This is the only concrete protocol implementation that ships in the repo (OAuth2/OIDC-style); there is no SAML implementation under `internal/idp`.

### Supporting context (not the abstraction/impl themselves)
- `/bench/repo/store/idp.go` and `/bench/repo/store/db/{sqlite,postgres,mysql}/idp.go` — persistence of IdP configs.
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/idp_service.go` and `auth_service_sso.go` — the API/service layer that wires IdP configs to login; this is where the oauth2 provider is instantiated and invoked.
- `/bench/repo/proto/gen/store/idp.pb.go` — generated `OAuth2Config` / IdP config protobuf types consumed by the oauth2 package.</result>
